remarks: Sunny and bright 1 bedroom, 1.5 bath townhouse in Glenbrook, perfect for both investors and end users. Enjoy a prime location near the Metro North train station to NYC, Downtown Stamford, shopping, and restaurants. The townhouse features an open layout with living room/fireplace, dining area, powder room, and kitchen with recent stainless steel appliances. The Primary bedroom suite includes a walk-in closet and a full bath with a linen closet. This property offers assigned garage space and a large storage room. Don't miss out on this opportunity!
